descriptions.rgb: The camera is tilted downward and rotates across the strip, showing the wearer’s red-clad torso and arms within about 0.2–0.5 m, with a rough floor, a concrete wall or column, and an open framed area farther away. A person in tan patterned clothing is crouched or seated roughly 0.8–1.5 m in front of the wearer, generally facing toward them, although their face is partly obscured by headgear, hands, and the frame edges. A second person in high-visibility yellow-green clothing is only partly visible near the periphery, about 1.5–3 m away and roughly 1–2 m from the tan-clad person; their facing direction and gaze are not clearly visible. A yellow measuring tape or line runs diagonally across the floor within about 0.5–1.5 m of the wearer and passes near the tan-clad person, while the wearer’s own arms and torso occlude much of the central and lower view. From frames 1 through 5, the camera turns clockwise and slightly shifts toward the tan-clad person, moving that person from upper-left/center toward the right side while the high-visibility person changes from a partial edge view to a partial upper-left view; no large approach or retreat is evident.
